summary.headline: Astrological Excerpts on Signs
summary.text: Catalogue of short astrological excerpts on the zodiacal signs, solar and lunar projection, lunar and solar eclipses, comets, the starless ninth heaven, royal death, rain and drought, and determining the ruling star by annual signs. Cross-references are given to codex Mediol. 7, folio 43v, and codex Taurin. 5, folio 83v.
